topic: It was reported that prices had risen
title: It was reported that prices had risen

lines.en: Did you see the news last night, Ana? It was reported that prices had risen again in just three months.
lines.pt: Você viu o noticiário ontem à noite, Ana? Noticiaram que os preços tinham subido de novo em apenas três meses.

lines.en: I did. It was said that energy bills had gone up by almost a fifth before the winter even started.
lines.pt: Vi. Disseram que as contas de energia tinham subido quase um quinto antes mesmo de o inverno começar.

lines.en: And food is believed to have become much more expensive too. My mother says she had never paid so much for bread.
lines.pt: E acredita-se que a comida também ficou bem mais cara. Minha mãe diz que nunca tinha pago tanto por pão.

lines.en: It was claimed that the shops had warned their suppliers months ago, but nobody had listened.
lines.pt: Alegaram que as lojas tinham avisado os fornecedores meses atrás, mas ninguém tinha ouvido.

lines.en: Really? The minister is thought to have ignored those warnings, although she denied it on the programme.
lines.pt: Sério? Acredita-se que a ministra ignorou esses avisos, embora ela tenha negado isso no programa.

lines.en: A new support package was announced for next spring, but the details had not been published yet.
lines.pt: Um novo pacote de apoio foi anunciado para a próxima primavera, mas os detalhes ainda não tinham sido publicados.

lines.en: That’s typical. By the time it arrives, many families will have spent their savings, I’m afraid.
lines.pt: Isso é típico. Quando chegar, muitas famílias já terão gasto suas economias, receio.

lines.en: It was reported that two local banks had offered cheaper loans, so maybe people are being helped a little.
lines.pt: Noticiaram que dois bancos locais tinham oferecido empréstimos mais baratos, então talvez as pessoas estejam sendo ajudadas um pouco.

lines.en: Maybe, but borrowing more is risky. Inflation was said to have slowed down, yet nobody feels any difference.
lines.pt: Talvez, mas pedir mais emprestado é arriscado. Disseram que a inflação tinha desacelerado, mas ninguém sente diferença.

lines.en: Exactly. I’d trust the figures more if the reporters had checked them properly before the broadcast.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Eu confiaria mais nos números se os repórteres os tivessem conferido direito antes da transmissão.

lines.en: Good point. Let’s read the full report online tonight instead of relying on a short headline.
lines.pt: Bom ponto. Vamos ler o relatório completo online hoje à noite em vez de confiar numa manchete curta.

facts.big: It was reported that + had + particípio
facts.label: Passivo de relato
facts.sub: It was reported that prices had risen. Prices were said to have risen. Fonte omitida; passado anterior com had.

facts.label: Noticiaram
facts.sub: Use It was reported that + oração para dar notícia sem dizer quem falou: It was reported that prices had risen. Comum em jornais e no rádio. Também: It was said, It was claimed.

facts.label: had + particípio
facts.sub: Use had + particípio para algo anterior a outro momento do passado: The shops had warned their suppliers. Na negativa: had not (hadn’t) published. Evite usar have no lugar de had.
